title: Structural Distortion Explorer
disclaimer: Exaggerated, qualitative visualisation. Not to scale, no units.
nature: Qualitative and exaggerated: nothing is calibrated and no quantity carries units. Loads, strains and buckling thresholds are dimensionless slider fractions.

structures.label: Circular tube
structures.boundary: cantilever, clamped at x = 0, loaded at the free end

structures.label: Rectangular box
structures.boundary: cantilever, clamped at x = 0, loaded at the free end

structures.label: I-beam
structures.boundary: cantilever, clamped at x = 0, loaded at the free end

structures.label: Stiffened panel
structures.type: flat skin with 3 longitudinal stringers and 2 transverse frames, 2:1 aspect ratio, stiffeners toggleable
structures.boundary: loaded in its own plane: in-plane shear and axial load only

effects.label: Poisson contraction or swell
effects.note: lateral strain = -ν × axial strain, with ν drawn at its upper limit 0.5 so the swell shows; the clamp holds it back over a short length

effects.label: Bending
effects.note: Euler-Bernoulli: plane sections stay plane and normal to the bent axis; the moment of a tip force falls linearly to zero at the tip

effects.label: In-plane shear of the panel
effects.note: uniform pure shear of the skin; stiffeners follow the skin

effects.label: Transverse shear
effects.note: thin-walled shear flow gives the wall shear strain; sections drift and warp. The bending moment a tip force also causes is left to the bending slider

effects.label: Saint-Venant torsion
effects.note: rigid rotation of each section about the shear centre

effects.label: Torsional warping
effects.note: axial displacement -φ'ω from the sectorial coordinate ω: Vlasov for the open I-beam, the Bredt cell for the box (small), none for the circular tube. With the restraint toggle on, warping is held at the clamp and the twist rate follows φ'(x) ∝ 1 - cosh(λ(L - x))/cosh(λL)

effects.label: Shear lag
effects.note: box flanges under bending: a cosine distribution of axial displacement across the flange, so the flange strain peaks at the webs

effects.label: Buckling wrinkles
effects.note: threshold-triggered: flat below the critical load, then wrinkles growing as √(r - 1) with the interaction ratio r = σ/σcr + (τ/τcr)². Shear: diagonal half-waves at about 45° with crests along the tension diagonal; compression: square half-waves. Panel skin (shear and compression), box walls (shear, and compression on the compression flange), I-beam web (shear); the tube stays smooth

effects.label: Buckling thresholds
effects.note: σcr ∝ k_c/b and τcr ∝ k_s/b_short with the classical plate coefficients: the true (t/b)² dependence is compressed so every case buckles inside the slider range, while stiffeners, which shrink the plates, still raise the threshold and shorten the waves
